core_claim.quote: In this scenario, consciousness is not a matter of computation, and conscious AI would need to be ‘living’ AI.

source.citation: Seth AK. Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism. Behavioral and Brain Sciences 49, e315 (published online 2025-04-21)

prediction.statement: Conventional AI will not become conscious by getting more capable or by running the right computations; consciousness will not arrive as a side effect of intelligence.

first_stated.passage: Consciousness will not just come along for the ride as AI gets smarter, despite the pull of our anthropocentric and anthropomorphic biases.

source.citation: Seth AK. Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism. Behavioral and Brain Sciences 49, e315 (published online 2025-04-21)
